name: Kisaragi Noe
source:
Romantic Stance: After coming to like someone, cannot hold back her feelings
Emotion towards protagonist: Thinks "Is every guy in city like this..?"

Second year high school student. Girl in liberal arts, who loves reading and insects, above all else.

Besides helping in the inn where the protagonist resides, spends most of her free time on her hobbies.

Personality is mostly about doing things at her own pace. Has communication ability and despite being modest, has strong curiosity.

"If I come to like a person, I am sure I won't be able to confess by myself."

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=903610]Getchu[/url]]
